knowledge_base.cause: Connection pool exhausted — the overnight batch held connections open and never released them.
knowledge_base.fix: Check active sessions, kill the idle batch sessions, then restart the connection pool. Do NOT restart the app first — the pool will exhaust again within minutes.
knowledge_base.symptom: Checkout fails: database connection timeout after 30s

knowledge_base.cause: tnsnames.ora still points at the retired database host after the database move.
knowledge_base.fix: Update tnsnames.ora to the new host, verify with tnsping, then re-run the billing job from the failed step.
knowledge_base.symptom: Billing job fails: TNS: could not resolve the connect identifier

knowledge_base.cause: Payment API returns a null tax field for one province, and checkout does not handle a null tax value.
knowledge_base.fix: Apply the null-check patch (or ask the dev team for it), then re-run the failed orders from the payment queue. Confirm the tax value is present before re-running.
knowledge_base.symptom: Checkout returns HTTP 500 on payment confirm

knowledge_base.cause: New app version is listening on the wrong port, so the web server cannot reach it.
knowledge_base.fix: Check the port in the app config against the web server config, fix the port, restart the app service, then verify the login page loads.
knowledge_base.symptom: App shows 'Bad Gateway' for all users after a deploy

knowledge_base.cause: Sender's SFTP password expired, so the transfer is refused at login.
knowledge_base.fix: Confirm with the sender, reset the SFTP credential, ask the sender to re-send the file, then verify it arrived on disk (not just in the log).
knowledge_base.symptom: Settlement file upload rejected: 550 Permission denied

knowledge_base.cause: Source sent the same extract file twice, so the load tried to insert the same customers again.
knowledge_base.fix: Check the file checksum against yesterday's file, delete the duplicate rows from the staging table, then re-run the load.
knowledge_base.symptom: Nightly load fails: duplicate key on customer_id

knowledge_base.cause: Payment gateway vendor latency spike — the vendor's own status page showed degraded service.
knowledge_base.fix: Check the vendor status page first. Retry failed authorisations with back-off; queue any that still fail and re-run them once the vendor reports recovered. Do not re-charge the customer twice.
knowledge_base.symptom: Card authorisation fails with a gateway timeout

knowledge_base.cause: Cached login token is not cleared when the password is reset, so the old token keeps being sent.
knowledge_base.fix: Sign the user out everywhere (or clear the cached token), then log in again with the new password. No reset needed.
knowledge_base.symptom: CRM login fails: token expired straight after a password change

knowledge_base.cause: The same customer was edited in CRM and in billing at the same time, so the sync cannot pick a winner.
knowledge_base.fix: Take the record with the newer updated timestamp as the source of truth, apply it to the other system, then re-run the sync for that customer only.
knowledge_base.symptom: CRM sync conflict: same customer record updated in both systems

knowledge_base.cause: Consumer thread deadlocked on one poison message it cannot process.
knowledge_base.fix: Move the poison message to the dead-letter queue, restart the consumer, then check the stuck orders process in order.
knowledge_base.symptom: Orders stuck: queue consumer stalled, no errors in the log

knowledge_base.cause: Unescaped comma inside a customer name field shifted every column after it.
knowledge_base.fix: Quote the field (or ask the source to fix the export), then re-import starting from the failed row — not from the top.
knowledge_base.symptom: Report import fails: malformed row at line 214

knowledge_base.cause: Report query scans the full history table because no date filter was applied.
knowledge_base.fix: Add a date filter for the reporting month, re-run the report, and schedule it off-peak so it does not compete with the morning batch.
knowledge_base.symptom: Monthly report fails with a timeout after 10 minutes
